prerequisites: Method for processing and modelling electrical circuits.

learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to propose a ‘complex’ cascaded structure of static converters to enable specific electrical energy conversion.
Students will have knowledge of the electrical phenomena that penalise conversion efficiency but which are inherent in real structures.
Students will be able to approach both with confidence and caution, the proposal of an architecture, its simulation, and the rules of recommendation for the choice of the inner elements.
Be able to propose an elementary or complex conversion structure.
Determine the internal components and how they are controlled.
Understand and be able to describe the influence of a non-perfect switch in a conversion diagram.
Be able to represent signal waveforms in advance.
Dimension the passive elements associated with the structure with a view to filtering the waveforms.
Use simulation tools to validate these dimensions.

syllabus_topics: Design of a power conversion chain (mini-project)
Sizing of filter elements for waveform quality improvement
Introductory section linking to environmental challenges, energy transition, greenhouse gas reduction, and industrial decarbonation
teaching_methods: Confrontation of results with practical cases
